from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentCase(BaseModel):
    """Extracted features from one judicial document for case type classification."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment/ruling document")
    case_type_label: str | None = Field(description="How the document itself labels its case type, e.g., '刑事二审判决书', '行政再审审查裁定书', '民事二审判决书'")
    legal_basis: list[str] = Field(description="Statutes/cited laws that indicate the case type")
    parties_description: str | None = Field(description="Description of the parties involved, indicating case type")
    case_nature: str | None = Field(description="Core nature of the dispute or claim as described in the document")
    procedural_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of proceeding, e.g., '二审', '再审', '一审', '执行异议之诉'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentCase]
